email.subject: Quick note on Ironside Co Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I was looking at local auto shop sites in Harbor Falls and noticed a couple of things on yours likely costing you calls. There's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching for a mechanic nearby have to manually dial instead of tapping once. And there are no customer reviews showing, which matters a lot when people are picking between a few shops.

Smaller stuff too: the footer looks outdated and the page title doesn't say much about what you do.

Happy to walk through it with you for free, 10 minutes, no pitch. Let me know if you're open to it.

Alex
